request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Add only one thing: a small black iron shoulder pad with three bold hazard yellow diagonal stripes and a rusty rim on his shoulder, where the chest strap meets it. Do not touch his head, skin or ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: the orange-brown leather headband, chest strap, wrist wraps and loincloth, the green skin, belt, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
